blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The Zamboanga del Sur provincial government has rolled out a P497-million, 10-year solid waste management program to curb mounting garbage issues in its urban centers and waterways. Gov. Divina Grace Yu formally reconstituted the Provincial Solid Waste Management Board (PSWMB) through Executive Order No. 17, Series of 2026, setting in motion the province’s 2026–2035 Solid Waste Management Plan.
